label: conj:weakly_closed_equiv_F_pure_in_char_2
title: Conjecture
body_md:
\label{conj:weakly_closed_equiv_F_pure_in_char_2}
Let $G$ be a graph. Assume that the characteristic of the base field $\Bbbk$ is two. Then, $G$ is weakly closed if and only if $R_{G}$ is F-pure.
head: environment
name: Matsuda {}

label: thm:matsudas_conjecture_is_true
title: Theorem
body_md:
\label{thm:matsudas_conjecture_is_true}
Conjecture \ref{conj:weakly_closed_equiv_F_pure_in_char_2} is true.
head: environment

label: conj:bei_are_eventually_F_pure
title: Conjecture
body_md:
\label{conj:bei_are_eventually_F_pure}
Let $G$ be a graph, and let $p$ denote the characteristic of the base field. Then $R_{G}$ is F-pure for all sufficiently large $p > 0$.
head: environment
name: Matsuda {}

label: thm:intro_non_f_purity
title: Theorem
body_md:
\label{thm:intro_non_f_purity}
If $G$ contains an asteroidal triple, then $R_{G}$ is not F-pure in any positive characteristic.  In particular, Conjecture~\ref{conj:bei_are_eventually_F_pure} is false.
head: environment
name: Theorem \ref{thm:non_F_purity}, Corollary \ref{cor:at_triple_implies_non_f_purity}

label: prop:reg:sequence
title: Proposition
body_md:
\label{prop:reg:sequence}
    Let $R = \Bbbk[x_1,\ldots,x_n]$ be a polynomial ring, and let $f_1,\ldots,f_t \in R$ be a homogeneous regular sequence.  For $\alpha \in \mathbb{N}^t$, write $f^\alpha = \prod_{i = 1}^t f_i^{\alpha_i}$.  Then \[(f^{\alpha_1},\ldots,f^{\alpha_r}) \cap (f^{\beta_1},\ldots,f^{\beta_s}) = (\mathrm{lcm}(f^{\alpha_i},f^{\beta_j}) \mid 1 \le i \le r, 1 \le j \le s).\]
head: environment

title: Proof
body_md: First, note that the subring $S = \Bbbk[f_1,\ldots,f_t]$ is isomorphic to a polynomial ring in $t$ variables.  In $S$, the intersection amounts to a statement about the intersection of monomial ideals, which is well-known; see e.g. \cite[Proposition 2.1.5]{MRSW2018}.  The conclusion follows since the extension $S \to R$ is flat.
